issues.kind: instructional gap, not a proven game-rules defect
issues.title: Dependency mnemonic omits the conditions for replenishing/keeping stealth reserve
issues.repro: Read Stealth path; it says event → Touchstone credit → Corsair reduction, but has no Touchstone/Corsair read links beside the lesson. In game I expected another same-turn event to add reserve and tried installing a second Touchstone; the observed reserve and replacement did not match those assumptions.
issues.fix: Link Read Touchstone and Read Corsair directly from the dependency lesson; state applicable first-event timing and active-copy restriction from the actual card. Add one short install/event/reserve check before the run.
issues.acceptance: A Gateway graduate can explain how to accumulate two stealth credits, why a second event that turn may not recharge, and whether installing another copy preserves the existing reserve after reading the path and linked cards.
issues.confidence: Observed behavior is recorded; I did not inspect private rules implementation, so confirm exact timing/unique text before changing copy.

issues.title: Strength4 Palisade example lacks its remote-server condition
issues.repro: Guide arithmetic starts strength4Palisade. Actual Palisade encountered on R&D wasstrength2, requiring one reduction. Copying two reductions mechanically would waste stealth.
issues.fix: Say 'Palisade protecting a remote is strength4; on a central it is2. Check current strength first.' Confirm printed card text for wording.
issues.acceptance: Lesson gives current-strength check and explains central2→0 needsone stealth versusremote4→1→0 needs two.

issues.kind: game UI copy defect outside guide

issues.repro: Reach Manegarm with exactly2clicks and nocredits. Its payment button's rendered DOM text is 'Spend ClickClick'.
issues.fix: Render text 'Spend 2 clicks' with accessible numeric cost.
issues.acceptance: Visible and accessible labels clearly say2clicks; selecting it spends2 and continuesbreach.

preferences.title: Add one example opening/mulligan checklist for Gateway graduates
preferences.detail: Income first, Touchstone before relevant event, matching breaker and reserves, read damage/advancingremote; existing broad reminder did not determine this without my own knowledge.

limitations: One game only; no baseline paired comparison and no strength inference from Runner8–6.
DZMZ already has2 baseline copies, so observing it does not establish that the added third copy caused the opening draw or outcome.
Pantograph was drawn and discarded as my cash/hand decision; absence at steals shows opportunity, not measured lost value.
Snapshot timed out; no visual/layout/accessibility claims beyond rendered DOM text.

Tester errors: kept a no-income opening; queued a next-turn R&D path before re-reading newly installed outer barriers; expected same-turn event recharge; tried replacement Touchstone. Failed batches stopped on absent rendered controls. No wrong-breaker blind boosting, storage reset, private state or headless injection.
Detailed trace is a selected UI/action/strategy log; session.choices is the complete engine action record captured only after game end.
